pr.title: Optimize header layout performance with flexbox mixins

raw_findings.body: In that markup `.panel` is no longer a flex item, so neither `margin-left: auto` nor `@include order(3)` applies and the previous `float: right` is gone; the login/sign-up panel stops being right-aligned and drops to its own line under the site logo in the non-Ember header.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Header layout regression (panel wraps to a new line) in the server-rendered/anonymous header path.
raw_findings.impact: In that markup `.panel` is no longer a flex item, so neither `margin-left: auto` nor `@include order(3)` applies and the previous `float: right` is gone; the login/sign-up panel stops being right-aligned and drops to its own line under the site logo in the non-Ember header.
raw_findings.root_cause: The patch converts `.contents` to a flex container and replaces float-based positioning with flex-only positioning, but one consumer of these classes nests `.panel` inside an extra `.row` wrapper so the flex properties never take effect.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Either keep `float: right` (harmless for real flex items, since floats are ignored on them) or flatten `_header.html.erb` so `.panel` is a direct child of `.contents` before relying on `margin-left: auto`/`order`.
raw_findings.title: Removing `float: right` from `.panel` breaks the server-rendered header, where `.panel` is not a flex item
raw_findings.trigger: Anonymous/first-paint or crawler rendering of `app/views/application/_header.html.erb`, where the markup is `.contents > .row > .panel` — `.panel` is a child of `.row`, not of the `.contents` element that now gets `@include flexbox()`.

raw_findings.body: The 4em left padding that the -40px negative margin was pulling back against is gone, so the custom message is shifted ~40px to the left of its container, overlapping the small-action avatar/icon or running off the content edge.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Visual overlap/misalignment of small-action custom messages on mobile.
raw_findings.impact: The 4em left padding that the -40px negative margin was pulling back against is gone, so the custom message is shifted ~40px to the left of its container, overlapping the small-action avatar/icon or running off the content edge.
raw_findings.root_cause: Left padding (`0.5em 0 0.5em 4em`) was replaced with `0 1.5%` without updating the mobile rule that was written to compensate for the old 4em indent.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Update or remove the `.custom-message { margin-left: -40px; }` override in `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss` in the same patch, or retain enough left padding on `.small-action-desc` to keep that offset valid.
raw_findings.title: `.small-action-desc` padding change leaves mobile `.custom-message { margin-left: -40px }` uncompensated
raw_findings.trigger: Viewing a small action post that has `post.cooked` (renders `.custom-message`) on the mobile stylesheet, where `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss:516-522` still applies `.small-action .small-action-desc .custom-message { margin-left: -40px; }`.

raw_findings.body: Those elements get old-spec box layout with no cross-axis alignment at all (no `-moz-box-align`), so header contents / small-action rows are top-aligned instead of centered, while the sibling `order()` mixin does emit `-moz-box-ordinal-group`, making prefix coverage inconsistent.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Cross-axis alignment silently missing on the legacy Gecko code path the patch deliberately enables.
raw_findings.impact: Those elements get old-spec box layout with no cross-axis alignment at all (no `-moz-box-align`), so header contents / small-action rows are top-aligned instead of centered, while the sibling `order()` mixin does emit `-moz-box-ordinal-group`, making prefix coverage inconsistent.
raw_findings.root_cause: New prefix-fallback mixins were added with inconsistent vendor coverage between the display mixins and the alignment mixin.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add `-moz-box-align: $alignment;` to the `align-items` mixin (or drop `display: -moz-box`/`-moz-inline-box` from the display mixins so no old-spec Gecko path is created).
raw_findings.title: `align-items` mixin omits `-moz-box-align` although `flexbox()`/`inline-flex()` emit `-moz-box`
raw_findings.trigger: A legacy Gecko engine that resolves `display: -moz-box` (emitted by the new `flexbox()`/`inline-flex()` mixins) rendering `.d-header .contents`, `.small-action` or `.badge-wrapper.bullet`.

raw_findings.body: Each generated rule carries a declaration no browser has ever implemented (IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align`, already emitted on the previous line), adding unused bytes to every stylesheet and misleading future maintainers into thinking an IE-specific alias exists.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Dead CSS emitted at every include site; reviewers/maintainers get incorrect prefix guidance.
raw_findings.impact: Each generated rule carries a declaration no browser has ever implemented (IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align`, already emitted on the previous line), adding unused bytes to every stylesheet and misleading future maintainers into thinking an IE-specific alias exists.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new mixin was written with a fabricated `-ms-` alias in addition to the correct `-ms-flex-align`.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Delete the `-ms-align-items: $alignment;` line from the `align-items` mixin.
raw_findings.title: `-ms-align-items` is not a real property and is dead output of the new mixin
raw_findings.trigger: Every compilation of the three call sites (`header.scss:18`, `topic-post.scss:265`, `badges.css.scss:57`) that include `align-items()`.

raw_findings.body: The `align-items` mixin body is indented 4 spaces and this declaration ends with two trailing spaces, producing inconsistent formatting and stray whitespace diffs/lint noise in a file the same patch otherwise formats with 2 spaces.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Style inconsistency and trailing-whitespace lint noise in the newly added block.
raw_findings.impact: The `align-items` mixin body is indented 4 spaces and this declaration ends with two trailing spaces, producing inconsistent formatting and stray whitespace diffs/lint noise in a file the same patch otherwise formats with 2 spaces.
raw_findings.root_cause: New mixin added without following the surrounding file's indentation/whitespace convention.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Re-indent the `align-items` mixin body to 2 spaces, strip the trailing spaces on the `-ms-flex-align` line, and add a space after the colon in `align-items:$alignment;`.
raw_findings.title: New `align-items` mixin violates the file's 2-space formatting and adds trailing whitespace
raw_findings.trigger: Reading or editing `mixins.scss`, where every other mixin (`flexbox()`, `inline-flex()`, `order()` in this same patch, and all pre-existing mixins) indents declarations with 2 spaces and has no trailing whitespace.
